comments.author: frank
comments.body: Returning a bare dict from the service loses all structure. Make `CustomerView` a Pydantic model: you get validation, `model_dump(mode="json")` handles the Decimal for you, and the handler becomes a one-liner. This is what we do in the platform services.

comments.author: dan
comments.body: Makes sense, the Decimal serialisation was annoying me anyway. Changed.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: Fine by me for now. We don't really have a rule about where Pydantic lives yet, might be worth one.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: nit: `mode="json"` is doing the heavy lifting here, maybe a comment? Not blocking.

comments.author: dan
comments.body: I think it's clear enough, leaving it.
